Routing Table

ENCRYPTED Unreadable payload Shadow Decryptors Decode + classify
MALFORMED 4xx spam, parse errors Error Eyes Repair + re-route
HIGH_VALUE_AI Claude, Google signatures AI Gate Research tasks

Decoupled Compute Model

BILLING COMPUTE (Cloudflare CPU) ├─ What Cloudflare charges you for ├─ Every Worker invocation = billed CPU slice └─ Current state: tightly coupled (every thought = bill) ORGANISM COMPUTE (Internal Cycles) ├─ How the system thinks, routes, remembers, evolves ├─ NOT 1:1 mapped to Cloudflare CPU ├─ Lives in: distributed memory, learned patterns, cache agents └─ Goal: costless internal cycles ARCHITECTURE: Outer Membrane: Minimal, cheap, dumb ├─ Terminate TLS ├─ Classify roughly (pattern matching, not AI) └─ Hand off to cache-organism Inner Organism: Semi-autonomous ├─ Persistent state across requests ├─ Learned patterns in cache entries ├─ "Dynamic" responses from cache layer └─ Cloudflare sees "cache hit"; organism sees cognition
